title: A pack's demo identities (demo/identities.json), read by the workshop rung 'populated'
description: Who the demo data is created as. The workshop boots a throwaway app, gives each identity below a throwaway API key, puts the keys and the app URL in the environment of the Mockuper process under the names declared here, and runs demo/mockuper.yaml with --cache-only --apply against that app. Keys are never written to a file. demo/mockuper.yaml must name the same environment variables (output.api.base_url_env and each identity's value_env).

targetUrlEnv.description: environment variable that holds the app URL (the mockuper.yaml's output.api.base_url_env)

role.description: the role the app gives this identity (the pack's role token)

keyEnv.description: environment variable that holds this identity's API key (that identity's value_env in mockuper.yaml)
